note: Question bank for full mocks and smart practice. Written fresh for this app in SSC MTS style. The 5 AM update adds new GA and English questions every day.

q.q: Who founded the Maurya Empire?
q.e: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire around 322 BCE with help from Chanakya.
q.ml: ചന്ദ്രഗുപ്ത മൗര്യനാണ് മൗര്യ സാമ്രാജ്യം സ്ഥാപിച്ചത്. ചാണക്യൻ സഹായിച്ചു.

q.q: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
q.e: Plassey: 1757 (Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah). Buxar: 1764. Third Panipat: 1761.

q.q: Who gave the slogan 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement?
q.e: Gandhiji gave 'Do or Die' in 1942 at the start of the Quit India Movement.
q.ml: 1942-ലെ ക്വിറ്റ് ഇന്ത്യ സമരത്തിൽ ഗാന്ധിജി 'പ്രവർത്തിക്കുക അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മരിക്കുക' എന്ന് പറഞ്ഞു.

q.q: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
q.e: Jallianwala Bagh is in Amritsar, Punjab. It happened on 13 April 1919.

q.q: Who was the first Governor-General of independent India?
q.e: Lord Mountbatten was the first. C. Rajagopalachari was the first (and last) Indian Governor-General.
q.ml: സ്വതന്ത്ര ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ആദ്യ ഗവർണർ ജനറൽ മൗണ്ട് ബാറ്റൺ. ആദ്യ ഇന്ത്യക്കാരൻ രാജാജി.

q.q: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
q.e: INC was founded in 1885 by A. O. Hume. First session in Bombay, president W. C. Bonnerjee.
q.ml: ഇന്ത്യൻ നാഷണൽ കോൺഗ്രസ് 1885-ൽ സ്ഥാപിച്ചു. സ്ഥാപകൻ എ. ഒ. ഹ്യൂം.

q.q: Vasco da Gama landed at which place in Kerala in 1498?
q.e: Vasco da Gama reached Kappad near Kozhikode (Calicut) in May 1498.
q.ml: 1498-ൽ വാസ്കോ ഡ ഗാമ കോഴിക്കോട് കാപ്പാട് എത്തി.

q.q: Who started building the Qutub Minar?
q.e: Qutb-ud-din Aibak started it; Iltutmish completed it.
q.ml: ഖുതുബ് മിനാർ തുടങ്ങിയത് കുത്തബ്ദ്ദീൻ ഐബക്. പൂർത്തിയാക്കിയത് ഇൽത്തുമിഷ്.

q.q: How many Fundamental Duties are there in the Indian Constitution now?
q.e: There are 11 Fundamental Duties (Article 51A). 10 were added in 1976, the 11th in 2002.

q.q: Which Article of the Constitution abolishes untouchability?
q.e: Article 17 abolishes untouchability. Article 14 = equality, 21 = life, 32 = constitutional remedies.

q.q: Who is known as the 'Father of the Indian Constitution'?
q.e: Dr B. R. Ambedkar was chairman of the Drafting Committee.
q.ml: ഡോ. ബി. ആർ. അംബേദ്കർ - ഡ്രാഫ്റ്റിംഗ് കമ്മിറ്റി ചെയർമാൻ.

q.q: What is the minimum age to become President of India?
q.e: President: 35 years. Lok Sabha member: 25. Rajya Sabha member: 30.
q.ml: രാഷ്ട്രപതി ആകാൻ കുറഞ്ഞ പ്രായം 35. ലോക്സഭ 25, രാജ്യസഭ 30.

q.q: Article 21A (Right to Education) covers children of which age group?
q.e: Free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14 (86th Amendment, 2002).
q.ml: 6 മുതൽ 14 വയസ്സ് വരെയുള്ള കുട്ടികൾക്ക് സൗജന്യ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസം.

q.q: Who presides over a joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament?
q.e: The Lok Sabha Speaker presides over a joint sitting (Article 108).

q.q: The Preamble of India was amended by which Amendment?
q.e: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added 'Socialist', 'Secular' and 'Integrity'.
q.ml: 42-ാം ഭേദഗതി (1976): സോഷ്യലിസ്റ്റ്, സെക്കുലർ, അഖണ്ഡത എന്നിവ ചേർത്തു.

q.q: Which is the longest river in India?
q.e: The Ganga is the longest river in India. Godavari is the longest river of South India.
q.ml: ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ഏറ്റവും നീളമുള്ള നദി ഗംഗ. ദക്ഷിണേന്ത്യയിൽ ഗോദാവരി.

q.q: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which state?
q.e: It passes through 8 states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram. Not Odisha.

q.q: Which is the longest river of Kerala?
q.e: Periyar (244 km) is the longest. Bharathapuzha is second.
q.ml: കേരളത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും നീളം കൂടിയ നദി പെരിയാർ (244 കി.മീ).

q.q: Anamudi, the highest peak of South India, is in which state?
q.e: Anamudi (2,695 m) is in Idukki district, Kerala.

q.q: Which planet is called the 'Red Planet'?
q.e: Mars looks red because of iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

q.q: The Palk Strait separates India from which country?
q.e: Palk Strait lies between Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka.

q.q: Which state has the longest coastline in India?
q.e: Gujarat has the longest coastline of any Indian state.

q.q: Black soil is best suited for growing which crop?
q.e: Black (regur) soil holds moisture and is ideal for cotton.
q.ml: കറുത്ത മണ്ണ് പരുത്തി കൃഷിക്ക് ഏറ്റവും അനുയോജ്യം.

q.q: Who regulates the money supply in India?
q.e: The Reserve Bank of India controls money supply and issues currency notes (except ₹1).

q.q: The RBI was established in which year?
q.e: RBI was set up on 1 April 1935 and nationalised in 1949.

q.q: GST was introduced in India from which date?
q.e: GST came into force on 1 July 2017 (101st Amendment).

q.q: Which Five-Year Plan was called the 'Mahalanobis Plan'?
q.e: The Second Plan (1956–61) was based on the P. C. Mahalanobis model and stressed heavy industry.

q.q: NITI Aayog replaced which body?
q.e: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission on 1 January 2015.
q.ml: നീതി ആയോഗ് 2015-ൽ ആസൂത്രണ കമ്മീഷന് പകരം വന്നു.

q.q: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
q.e: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl. Baking soda is NaHCO3, washing soda Na2CO3.

q.q: Which vitamin deficiency causes night blindness?
q.e: Night blindness: Vitamin A. Scurvy: C. Rickets: D. Beri-beri: B1.
q.ml: നിശാന്ധത - വിറ്റാമിൻ A കുറവ്. സ്കർവി - C. റിക്കറ്റ്സ് - D.

q.q: What is the SI unit of force?
q.e: Force: newton. Energy: joule. Pressure: pascal. Power: watt.

q.q: Which gas do plants take in for photosynthesis?
q.e: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen during photosynthesis.
q.ml: പ്രകാശസംശ്ലേഷണത്തിന് സസ്യങ്ങൾ കാർബൺ ഡൈ ഓക്സൈഡ് എടുക്കുന്നു.

q.q: Which is the largest organ of the human body?
q.e: Skin is the largest organ. Liver is the largest internal organ (and largest gland).
q.ml: ഏറ്റവും വലിയ അവയവം ത്വക്ക്. ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ആന്തരാവയവം കരൾ.

q.q: The pH value of pure water is:
q.e: Pure water is neutral, pH 7. Below 7 = acid, above 7 = base.

q.q: Which blood group is called the 'universal donor'?
q.e: O negative can be given to anyone. AB positive is the universal recipient.
q.ml: സാർവത്രിക ദാതാവ് O നെഗറ്റീവ്. സാർവത്രിക സ്വീകർത്താവ് AB പോസിറ്റീവ്.

q.q: Sound cannot travel through:
q.e: Sound needs a medium. It cannot travel in a vacuum.

q.q: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
q.e: Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature.

q.q: Kathakali is the classical dance of which state?
q.e: Kathakali and Mohiniyattam are from Kerala. Bharatanatyam: Tamil Nadu. Odissi: Odisha.

q.q: Who wrote the national anthem 'Jana Gana Mana'?
q.e: Tagore wrote Jana Gana Mana. Bankim Chandra wrote Vande Mataram (national song).
q.ml: ജനഗണമന എഴുതിയത് രവീന്ദ്രനാഥ ടാഗോർ. വന്ദേമാതരം ബങ്കിം ചന്ദ്ര.

q.q: Which is the national aquatic animal of India?
q.e: The Ganges river dolphin was declared the national aquatic animal in 2009.

q.q: Onam is mainly celebrated in which state?
q.e: Onam is the harvest festival of Kerala. Bihu: Assam. Baisakhi: Punjab.
q.ml: ഓണം - കേരളം. ബിഹു - അസം. ബൈശാഖി - പഞ്ചാബ്.

q.q: Kaziranga National Park is famous for which animal?
q.e: Kaziranga (Assam) is famous for the one-horned rhino. Gir (Gujarat) for Asiatic lions.

q.q: Silent Valley National Park is in which district of Kerala?
q.e: Silent Valley is in Palakkad district. It is famous for the lion-tailed macaque.
q.ml: സൈലന്റ് വാലി പാലക്കാട് ജില്ലയിൽ. സിംഹവാലൻ കുരങ്ങ്.

q.q: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
q.e: Indira Gandhi (1966). Pratibha Patil was the first woman President. Sucheta Kripalani was the first woman CM.

q.q: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
q.e: UN headquarters: New York. WHO: Geneva. UNESCO: Paris.

q.q: How many players are there in a hockey team on the field?
q.e: Hockey: 11. Kabaddi: 7. Volleyball: 6. Basketball: 5.
q.ml: ഹോക്കി ടീമിൽ കളത്തിൽ 11 പേർ. കബഡി 7, വോളിബോൾ 6.

q.q: The Durand Cup is associated with which sport?
q.e: The Durand Cup (since 1888) is one of Asia's oldest football tournaments.

q.q: Which is the highest sports award of India?
q.e: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna is the highest. Dronacharya is for coaches.
q.ml: ഏറ്റവും ഉയർന്ന കായിക ബഹുമതി മേജർ ധ്യാൻചന്ദ് ഖേൽരത്ന.

q.q: What does 'CPU' stand for?
q.e: CPU = Central Processing Unit, the brain of the computer.
q.ml: CPU = സെൻട്രൽ പ്രോസസ്സിംഗ് യൂണിറ്റ്, കമ്പ്യൂട്ടറിന്റെ തലച്ചോറ്.

q.q: Which shortcut key is used to copy?
q.e: Ctrl+C copy, Ctrl+V paste, Ctrl+X cut, Ctrl+Z undo.
q.ml: Ctrl+C കോപ്പി, Ctrl+V പേസ്റ്റ്, Ctrl+Z അൺഡു.

q.q: 1 kilobyte (KB) is equal to:
q.e: 1 KB = 1024 bytes. 1 byte = 8 bits.

q.q: The Sun Temple of Konark is in which state?
q.e: Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha, built by King Narasimhadeva I.

q.q: The Vaikom Satyagraha (1924–25) was a struggle for:
o: The right of all castes to use the roads near the temple
q.e: Vaikom Satyagraha demanded that people of all castes be allowed to use the public roads around the Vaikom temple. Leaders included T. K. Madhavan and K. Kelappan; Gandhiji supported it.
q.ml: വൈക്കം ക്ഷേത്രത്തിന് ചുറ്റുമുള്ള വഴികളിലൂടെ എല്ലാ ജാതിക്കാർക്കും നടക്കാനുള്ള അവകാശത്തിനായുള്ള സമരം.

q.q: Sree Narayana Guru consecrated a Shiva idol at which place in 1888?
q.e: The Aruvippuram consecration took place in 1888.

q.q: Which part of the cell is called its 'powerhouse'?
q.e: Mitochondria make energy (ATP) for the cell.

q.q: Which is the largest ocean in the world?
q.e: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest.

q.q: The Election Commission of India is described in which Article?
q.e: Article 324: Election Commission. 280: Finance Commission. 356: President's Rule.

q.q: Who was known as the 'Iron Man of India'?
q.e: Sardar Patel united the princely states and is called the Iron Man of India.

q.q: What is the full form of 'GDP'?
q.e: GDP = Gross Domestic Product: the value of all goods and services made in a country in a year.

q.q: Choose the correct option: She ___ to school every day.
q.e: With he/she/it in the simple present, add -s/-es: she goes.
q.ml: She/He/It കൂടെ present tense-ൽ verb-ന് -s/-es ചേർക്കണം: goes.

q.q: Choose the correct option: I have been living here ___ 2019.
q.e: 'Since' + a point in time (2019, Monday). 'For' + a period (5 years).
q.ml: ഒരു സമയബിന്ദു (2019) വന്നാൽ since; കാലയളവ് (5 years) വന്നാൽ for.

q.q: Choose the correct option: He is ___ honest man.
q.e: 'Honest' starts with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so use 'an'.
q.ml: honest-ൽ h ഉച്ചരിക്കില്ല, സ്വരശബ്ദം ആയതിനാൽ an.

q.q: Find the error: 'Each of the boys (A) / have (B) / a new bag (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: 'Each of' takes a singular verb: Each of the boys HAS a new bag.

q.q: Choose the correct option: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
q.e: In imaginary 'if' sentences we use 'were' for all subjects: If I were you.
q.ml: സാങ്കൽപ്പിക if വാക്യത്തിൽ were ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു: If I were you.

q.q: Choose the passive form: 'The cat killed the rat.'
o: The rat is killed by the cat.
The rat was killed by the cat.
The rat had killed the cat.
q.e: Simple past active → was/were + past participle: The rat was killed by the cat.
q.ml: Simple past passive: was/were + V3. The rat was killed by the cat.

q.q: Choose the correct option: The book is ___ the table.
q.e: 'On' is used for a surface: on the table.

q.q: Find the error: 'He did not (A) / went (B) / to the market (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: After 'did not' use the base verb: He did not GO.
q.ml: did not-ന് ശേഷം verb-ന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനരൂപം: go.

q.q: Choose the correct option: Neither Ram nor his friends ___ present.
q.e: With neither…nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('friends', plural): were.
q.ml: neither…nor-ൽ അടുത്തുള്ള subject (friends) അനുസരിച്ച് verb: were.

q.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'I am tired.'
o: He said that he is tired.
He said that he was tired.
He said that I was tired.
q.e: Reporting verb in past → present 'am' changes to past 'was'; 'I' becomes 'he'.
q.ml: said (past) ആയതിനാൽ am → was. I → he.

q.q: Choose the correct option: This is the ___ building in the city.
q.e: Comparing with all others in a group → superlative: the tallest.

q.q: Choose the correct option: He is good ___ mathematics.
q.e: The fixed phrase is 'good at' (a subject or skill).

q.q: Choose the correct option: The train ___ before we reached the station.
q.e: The earlier of two past actions takes past perfect: had left.
q.ml: രണ്ട് past കാര്യങ്ങളിൽ ആദ്യം നടന്നതിന് had + V3.

q.q: Choose the correct option: One of my friends ___ a doctor.
q.e: 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb: One of my friends is.

q.q: Choose the correct option: We ___ cricket yesterday.
q.e: 'Yesterday' shows the past: played.

q.q: Choose the correct option: She is afraid ___ dogs.
q.e: The fixed phrase is 'afraid of'.

q.q: Choose the correct option: The sun ___ in the east.
q.e: Universal truths use the simple present: The sun rises in the east.

q.q: Choose the correct option: I prefer tea ___ coffee.
q.e: 'Prefer' takes 'to': I prefer tea to coffee.
q.ml: prefer-ന് ശേഷം to: prefer tea to coffee.

q.q: Choose the correct option: ___ you help me, please?
q.e: 'Could you…?' is a polite request.

q.q: Find the error: 'The news (A) / are (B) / very good today (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: 'News' is uncountable and singular: The news IS very good.
q.ml: news singular ആണ്: The news is.

q.q: Which Gupta king is called the 'Napoleon of India'?
q.e: Historian V. A. Smith called Samudragupta the Napoleon of India for his conquests.

q.q: The state of Kerala was formed on:
q.e: Kerala was formed on 1 November 1956 (Kerala Piravi).

q.q: Which is the largest planet in the Solar System?
q.e: Jupiter is the largest planet.

q.q: The chemical symbol of gold is:
q.e: Gold = Au (from Latin 'Aurum'). Silver = Ag.

q.q: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
q.e: The President appoints the Chief Justice of India (Article 124).

q.q: Who was the first Indian to win a Nobel Prize?
q.e: Tagore won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1913 for 'Gitanjali'.
q.ml: ആദ്യ ഇന്ത്യൻ നോബൽ ജേതാവ് ടാഗോർ (1913, ഗീതാഞ്ജലി).

q.q: Which is the hottest planet?
q.e: Venus is hottest because its thick carbon dioxide air traps heat.

q.q: An earthquake is measured by a:
q.e: A seismograph records earthquakes. Barometer measures air pressure.

q.q: The capital of Australia is:
q.e: Canberra is the capital; Sydney is the biggest city.

q.q: Who is known as the Father of the Green Revolution in India?
q.e: M. S. Swaminathan led India's Green Revolution. Verghese Kurien led the White Revolution (milk).

q.q: The largest desert in India is the:
q.e: The Thar Desert is mostly in Rajasthan.

q.q: Who wrote 'The Discovery of India'?
q.e: Nehru wrote it in Ahmednagar Fort jail (1944).

q.q: National Sports Day in India is on:
q.e: 29 August is the birthday of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.

q.q: WWW stands for:
q.e: WWW = World Wide Web, invented by Tim Berners-Lee.

q.q: Theyyam is a ritual art form mainly of:
q.e: Theyyam is performed mainly in Kannur and Kasaragod.

q.q: Choose the correct option: She is senior ___ me.
q.e: Words like senior, junior and prefer take 'to'.

q.q: Choose the correct option: I have lived here ___ ten years.
q.e: 'For' + a length of time (ten years).

q.q: Find the error: 'He don't (A) / like (B) / coffee (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: He/She/It takes 'doesn't': He doesn't like coffee.

q.q: Choose the correct option: The children ___ playing in the park now.
q.e: 'Children' is plural and 'now' shows present: are playing.

q.q: Choose the passive form: 'Ravi writes a letter.'
o: A letter is written by Ravi.
A letter was written by Ravi.
A letter is wrote by Ravi.
A letter has written by Ravi.
q.e: Simple present passive: is/are + V3.

q.q: Choose the correct option: This is ___ best day of my life.
q.e: Superlatives (best, tallest) take 'the'.

q.q: Choose the correct option: Neither of the two answers ___ correct.
q.e: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb: is.

q.q: Choose the correct option: He gave me ___ advice.
q.e: 'Advice' is uncountable: use some, not a/an.

q.q: Choose the indirect speech: She said, 'I like mangoes.'
o: She said that she liked mangoes.
She said that I like mangoes.
She said that she likes mango.
q.e: Said (past) → like becomes liked; I becomes she.
q.ml: said → like മാറി liked; I → she.

q.q: Choose the correct option: The meeting starts ___ 9 o'clock.
q.e: Use 'at' for an exact clock time.

q.q: Choose the correct option: Mathematics ___ my favourite subject.
q.e: Subject names like Mathematics and Physics are singular.

q.q: Improve the sentence: 'He is more taller than his brother.'
q.e: Don't use 'more' with -er. Say: He is taller than his brother.

q.q: Choose the correct option: The boy ___ won the prize is my cousin.
q.e: 'Who' is used for a person doing the action.

q.q: Choose the correct option: I am looking forward to ___ you.
q.e: 'Looking forward to' takes verb + -ing.

q.q: Choose the correct option: Hardly had he left ___ it began to rain.
q.e: 'Hardly … when' is a fixed pair. ('No sooner … than' is the other.)

q.q: The SI unit of electric current is:
q.e: Current: ampere. Voltage: volt. Resistance: ohm. Power: watt.

q.q: Which lens is used to correct short-sightedness (myopia)?
q.e: Myopia: concave lens. Long-sightedness (hypermetropia): convex lens.

q.q: The speed of light in vacuum is about:
q.e: Light: about 3 lakh km per second = 3 × 10⁸ m/s. Sound in air: about 340 m/s.

q.q: Which instrument measures atmospheric pressure?
q.e: Barometer: air pressure. Hygrometer: humidity. Ammeter: current.

q.q: The unit of power is:
q.e: Power = work ÷ time, measured in watt.

q.q: Sound travels fastest in:
q.e: Sound is fastest in solids, slower in liquids, slowest in gases, and cannot travel in a vacuum.

q.q: The rainbow is formed because of:
q.e: Water drops split white light into seven colours (dispersion, with refraction and reflection).

q.q: An electric fuse works on the ___ effect of current.
q.e: Too much current heats and melts the fuse wire, breaking the circuit.

q.q: Baking soda is chemically:
q.e: Baking soda = NaHCO₃. Washing soda = Na₂CO₃. Common salt = NaCl.

q.q: Which gas is called 'laughing gas'?
q.e: N₂O is laughing gas, used as a mild anaesthetic.

q.q: The chemical symbol of iron is:
q.e: Iron = Fe (from Latin 'ferrum').

q.q: Vinegar contains which acid?
q.e: Vinegar: acetic acid. Lemon: citric acid. Curd: lactic acid.

q.q: Which is the most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere?
q.e: Nitrogen is about 78%; oxygen about 21%.

q.q: Rusting of iron needs:
q.e: Iron rusts when it reacts with oxygen in the presence of water (moisture).

q.q: The hardest natural substance is:
q.e: Diamond is a form of carbon and the hardest natural substance.

q.q: An acid turns blue litmus paper:
q.e: Acid: blue litmus → red. Base: red litmus → blue.

q.q: Which blood cells help in blood clotting?
q.e: Platelets help blood clot. RBCs carry oxygen; WBCs fight infection.

q.q: Deficiency of iodine causes:
q.e: Lack of iodine causes goitre (swelling of the thyroid).

q.q: The functional unit of the kidney is the:
q.e: Nephrons filter blood. Neurons are nerve cells; alveoli are in the lungs.

q.q: Malaria is spread by the:
q.e: Malaria: female Anopheles. Dengue: Aedes mosquito.

q.q: Which part of the plant makes food?
q.e: Leaves make food by photosynthesis using chlorophyll.

q.q: How many bones are there in an adult human body?
q.e: An adult has 206 bones.

q.q: How many Fundamental Rights are there now in the Constitution?
q.e: Six. The Right to Property was removed from Fundamental Rights by the 44th Amendment (1978).

q.q: Who is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
q.e: The President is the Supreme Commander (Article 53).

q.q: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha is:
q.e: Up to 552 members as per the Constitution. Rajya Sabha: up to 250.

q.q: Article 32 of the Constitution is about:
q.e: Ambedkar called Article 32 the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution.

q.q: The Constitution of India came into force on:
q.e: Adopted 26 November 1949; in force 26 January 1950.

q.q: Who was the first President of India?
q.e: Dr Rajendra Prasad (1950–1962).
q.ml: ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ആദ്യ രാഷ്ട്രപതി ഡോ. രാജേന്ദ്ര പ്രസാദ്.

q.q: The first Battle of Panipat (1526) was won by:
q.e: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi and founded the Mughal Empire.

q.q: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) began in:
q.e: Gandhiji marched from Sabarmati to Dandi in March–April 1930.

q.q: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
q.e: Arya Samaj was founded in 1875. Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the Brahmo Samaj.

q.q: Ashoka changed after the Kalinga war, which is in present-day:
q.e: Kalinga is modern Odisha; Ashoka turned to Buddhism after the war.

q.q: Who built the Taj Mahal?
q.e: Shah Jahan built it in memory of Mumtaz Mahal.

q.q: The Revolt of 1857 started at:
q.e: It began at Meerut on 10 May 1857.

q.q: Which is the largest state of India by area?
q.e: Rajasthan is the largest by area; Uttar Pradesh by population.

q.q: The Western Ghats are also called:
q.e: The Western Ghats are known as the Sahyadri.

q.q: Which river is called the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
q.e: Kosi causes frequent floods in Bihar.

q.q: The Standard Meridian of India passes through:
q.e: Indian Standard Time is based on 82.5° E, passing near Mirzapur (UP).

q.q: Which is the largest continent?
q.e: Asia is the largest continent by area and population.

q.q: Who presents the Union Budget in Parliament?
q.e: The Union Finance Minister presents the Budget (Article 112: Annual Financial Statement).

q.q: Indian currency notes (except ₹1) are issued by:
q.e: RBI issues notes; the ₹1 note is issued by the Ministry of Finance.

q.q: Which organisation regulates the stock market in India?
q.e: SEBI regulates securities markets. IRDAI: insurance.

q.q: NABARD mainly gives credit for:
q.e: NABARD = National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.

q.q: The Nobel Prize is given in how many fields?
q.e: Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Peace and Economic Sciences.

q.q: 'Wings of Fire' was written by:
q.e: Autobiography of Dr A. P. J. Abdul Kalam.
q.ml: 'വിങ്സ് ഓഫ് ഫയർ' എഴുതിയത് എ. പി. ജെ. അബ്ദുൽ കലാം.

q.q: The Ranji Trophy is related to:
q.e: Ranji Trophy is India's domestic first-class cricket championship.

q.q: Bihu is the festival of:
q.e: Bihu is Assam's harvest festival.

q.q: Which is the national animal of India?
q.e: The Bengal tiger is the national animal; the peacock is the national bird.
q.ml: ദേശീയ മൃഗം കടുവ; ദേശീയ പക്ഷി മയിൽ.

q.q: The famous dance 'Kuchipudi' belongs to:
q.e: Kuchipudi: Andhra Pradesh. Mohiniyattam: Kerala. Odissi: Odisha. Manipuri: Manipur.

q.q: Find the error: 'She do not (A) / know the answer (B) / to this question. (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: She takes 'does': She does not know.

q.q: Find the error: 'Each of the students (A) / have submitted (B) / the form. (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: 'Each of' takes a singular verb: has submitted.

q.q: Find the error: 'I am living (A) / in Kochi (B) / since 2020. (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: With 'since' + time, use present perfect continuous: I have been living.
q.ml: since 2020 → have been living. തെറ്റ് A.

q.q: Find the error: 'He is (A) / one of the best player (B) / in the team. (C) / No error (D)'
q.e: 'One of the' + plural noun: best players.
q.ml: 'one of the' കഴിഞ്ഞ് ബഹുവചനം: players. തെറ്റ് B.

q.q: Improve the underlined part: 'He did not came to office yesterday.' (did not came)
q.e: After 'did not', use the base verb: come.

q.q: Improve the underlined part: 'If I will see him, I will tell him.' (If I will see)
q.e: In 'if' clauses about the future, use simple present: If I see him.
q.ml: If വാക്യത്തിൽ will വേണ്ട: If I see.

q.q: Improve the underlined part: 'The weather is more better today.' (more better)
q.e: 'Better' is already comparative; do not add 'more'.

q.q: Improve the underlined part: 'She has gone to Delhi last week.' (has gone)
q.e: 'Last week' is finished past time → simple past: went.

q.q: Choose the passive form: 'They are building a new bridge.'
o: A new bridge is being built by them.
A new bridge was built by them.
A new bridge is built by them.
A new bridge has been building by them.
q.e: Present continuous passive: is/are + being + V3.
q.ml: Present continuous passive: is being built.

q.q: Choose the active form: 'The letter was written by Anu.'
q.e: 'Was written' is simple past passive → active: Anu wrote.

q.q: Choose the indirect speech: He said to me, 'Where do you live?'
o: He asked me where I lived.
He asked me where do I live.
He said me where I live.
He asked where did I live.
q.e: Questions become statements in indirect speech; 'do you live' → 'I lived'.
q.ml: ചോദ്യം → asked; do you live → I lived.

q.q: Choose the indirect speech: The teacher said, 'Sit down.'
o: The teacher told us to sit down.
The teacher said us sit down.
The teacher told that sit down.
The teacher asked that we sat down.
q.e: Commands use 'told/ordered + to + verb'.

q.q: Fill in the blank: The train arrived ___ the station on time.
q.e: 'Arrive at' a small place like a station.

q.q: Fill in the blank: She has been working here ___ five years.
q.e: 'For' + a length of time.

q.q: Fill in the blank: Neither the manager nor the clerks ___ present.
q.e: With neither…nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (clerks).

q.q: Fill in the blank: He is ___ European.
q.e: 'European' starts with a 'yoo' sound → 'a'.

q.q:
Arrange the parts to make a correct sentence: The boy / to school / every day / goes / on foot
(P) to school (Q) every day (R) goes (S) on foot — 'The boy ___'
q.e: The boy goes (R) to school (P) on foot (S) every day (Q).
q.ml: The boy goes to school on foot every day.

q.q: Arrange to make a sentence: 'My mother ___' (P) a cake (Q) for my birthday (R) baked (S) yesterday
q.e: My mother baked (R) a cake (P) for my birthday (Q) yesterday (S).
q.ml: My mother baked a cake for my birthday yesterday.

q.q: Arrange to make a sentence: 'We ___' (P) the exam (Q) hard (R) to pass (S) must study
q.e: We must study (S) hard (Q) to pass (R) the exam (P).
q.ml: We must study hard to pass the exam.

q.q: Arrange to make a sentence: 'The old man ___' (P) slowly (Q) the road (R) crossed (S) with a stick
q.e: The old man crossed (R) the road (Q) slowly (P) with a stick (S).
q.ml: The old man crossed the road slowly with a stick.

q.q: Arrange to make a sentence: 'Kerala ___' (P) for its (Q) is famous (R) backwaters (S) and beaches
q.e: Kerala is famous (Q) for its (P) backwaters (R) and beaches (S).
q.ml: Kerala is famous for its backwaters and beaches.

q.q: Arrange to make a sentence: 'If you ___' (P) every day (Q) you will (R) practise (S) improve
q.e: If you practise (R) every day (P), you will (Q) improve (S).
q.ml: If you practise every day, you will improve.

cloze.p: Ravi works in an office in Kochi. Every morning he (1) ___ up at six o'clock. He reads the newspaper (2) ___ he drinks his tea. Then he (3) ___ a bus to his office. He is never (4) ___ for work. His manager is very (5) ___ with him.

b.e: Two actions at the same time → while.
'Never late for work' fits the meaning.

cloze.p: Water is very important for all living things. We cannot (1) ___ without it. Many villages in India still (2) ___ from water shortage in summer. We must not (3) ___ water. We should repair leaking taps and (4) ___ rainwater. Small steps can make a big (5) ___.

b.e: After 'cannot', use the base verb: live.
Parallel with 'repair': should repair … and collect.
Fixed phrase: make a big difference.

cloze.p: Anu wanted to buy a gift for her father. She went (1) ___ a shop near her house. The shopkeeper showed her (2) ___ watches. She chose a (3) ___ one with a brown strap. Her father was very happy (4) ___ he saw it. He thanked her (5) ___ the lovely gift.

b.e: Time clause: when he saw it.

cloze.p: Exercise is good for our body and mind. Doctors (1) ___ that we walk for at least thirty minutes a day. Exercise (2) ___ our heart strong. It also helps us to (3) ___ well at night. People who exercise (4) ___ are usually happier. So, start today and make it a daily (5) ___.

b.e: 'Advise' is the verb; 'advice' is the noun.
